_what: One row created on SB-TEST-2026 by CC's live verification of the SAIRNbiz backup fix, 2026-09-30. Recorded here BY THE RUN THAT CREATED IT rather than discovered later -- the contract in docs/live-residue/README.md.
tool: sairnbiz-sync-proof (ad-hoc, driven from the session; NOT a tracked tool, and that is itself recorded below)
licence_note: The TEST licence, not the demo one. SB-PINNACLE-2026 was not touched -- its PIN is Michael's to restore and nothing here authenticates against it.
why: Blocker 2 of docs/2026-09-29-sairnbiz-preview-check.md could only be settled by a WRITE. The read half shows the tables answer; it cannot show whether a save lands. sb_po went 0 rows -> 1 row through /api/sd-data with a real owner session, and sb_incidents answered 503 NOT_PROVISIONED in the same run -- which is the whole diagnosis end to end: the endpoint was never the problem, a global latch was.

rows.accumulates_note: api/sd-data.js upserts sb_po on (license_hash, po_id) with resolution=merge-duplicates, so re-running the proof overwrites this row rather than adding another.

removal_sql: create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- Expect 87e7f2ee131c924eaa3bd282c9c207962d499dff151a00990d83482d291288fc. If it differs, STOP.
select encode(digest('SB-TEST-2026', 'sha256'), 'hex') as derived_license_hash;

-- SELECT FIRST. Expect exactly ONE row. If it returns more, or a different id, something other than the proof wrote here and the delete below is wrong.
select 'sb_po' as tbl, po_id as row_key, license_hash, created_at, data
  from public.sb_po
 where license_hash = encode(digest('SB-TEST-2026', 'sha256'), 'hex')
   and po_id = 'ZZ-CC-SYNCPROOF';

-- AND THE BLAST RADIUS: how many sb_po rows does this licence hold altogether? Expect 1. A larger total means real test content sits alongside and the predicate above is what you delete, never a broader one.
select count(*) as rows_for_this_licence
  from public.sb_po
 where license_hash = encode(digest('SB-TEST-2026', 'sha256'), 'hex');

-- Run as the table OWNER, not as service_role: sql/sairnbiz_data_schema.sql grants service_role select/insert/update and no DELETE, which is why no API path can remove this.
delete from public.sb_po
 where license_hash = encode(digest('SB-TEST-2026', 'sha256'), 'hex')
   and po_id = 'ZZ-CC-SYNCPROOF';

-- CONFIRM. Must be 0. A delete that reports success and leaves the row is what this third step exists for.
select count(*) as remaining
  from public.sb_po
 where license_hash = encode(digest('SB-TEST-2026', 'sha256'), 'hex')
   and po_id = 'ZZ-CC-SYNCPROOF';
and_this_run_was_not_a_tracked_tool: Recorded because it is the same gap as 2026-09-29: an ad-hoc script that writes is invisible to tools/live_probe_residue_audit.py, whose universe is tracked files under tools/ tests/ scripts/. The difference this time is that the residue is enumerated here, with the real id column, before anybody had to go looking for it. The proof was a one-off end-to-end diagnosis rather than a repeatable check, so it was not made a tool -- and if it needs repeating, it should be one.
